Name: Tweakable Meadowlands Farm
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png[/img]
This mod adds options to change part of Meadowlands Farm. Allowing you to choose between different variants of the maps and remove the ponds.
Now with tillable grass (configurable)!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url]﻿ is strongly recommended to edit the config in-game instead of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Configure_mods]editing manually[/url], but it's your choice.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HNm7QJU.png[/img]
[/size]1. Can I use this mod in an ongoing save?
[size=2]﻿Yes, you can! However, if you remove ponds, pond area will be an empty plot as default debris generation only occur during save file creation.

2. Can I remove this mod after using it in my save?
Yes, you can. The patch will not apply (ie. game will use default map). There's possibility of buildings or items on top of the pond. Especially if a pond was removed using the mod. Still, easily dealt with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url].

3. Can I use this mod in multiplayer?
Yes, you can. Ideally with mod installed and with same setting on all players. Otherwise, you might see other farmer walking on water.

Downloads.Description:
Added option:
- Remove fence
- Spawn three stumps daily in area with Grandpa Shrine
- Spawn forage like forest farm
- Add a spring map in bottom right of the map (require removed fence)
Changed dirt tile next to farm cave to be tillable
